answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh ocean challenge every epoch. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra pearl buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The mesa is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal epc0h.
